Class CliopatriaCulturalTaxonomyCatalog

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.CliopatriaCulturalTaxonomyCatalog
public final class CliopatriaCulturalTaxonomyCatalog extends Object
Cultural, Linguistic, Kinship, and Trait Taxonomy Catalog for Seshat ClioPatria Polities.

Extracted from CliopatriaPolityVectorReader to satisfy the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). Maps historical polity names and Seshat IDs to authentic cartographic color palettes and 4D cliodynamic trait vectors (language, kinship, subsistence, religion).

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • computePolityTraits

      public static double[] computePolityTraits(String name, String seshatId, long targetYear)
      Computes authentic 4D cliodynamic trait vector [linguisticBranch, socialStructure, subsistenceMode, ritualTradition] for a historical polity based on Glottolog 4.8 linguistic phyla, Murdock D-PLACE kinship structures, ArchaeoGLOBE subsistence regimes, and Seshat Databank institutional norms.
      Parameters:
      name - Name of historical polity
      seshatId - Seshat unique identifier (if present)
      targetYear - Target simulation epoch year
      Returns:
      4-dimensional normalized trait array in range [0.0, 1.0]
